provenance.headline: NO VERIFIED NBA 2K27 DATA IS PRESENT IN THIS DATASET.
explanation: Every numeric value in this dataset directory is a STRUCTURAL PLACEHOLDER. It exists so the
optimization engine, API and UI have something well-formed to run against. It is NOT sourced
from NBA 2K27, from 2K Sports, from Visual Concepts, or from any verified community dataset.
Placeholder values are shaped like values from the NBA 2K series so that the data model is
realistic, but the specific numbers should be assumed WRONG until a human replaces them.
Attribute names, badge names, animation names and archetype names are likewise unverified for
2K27 and may not exist in the shipped game.
provenance.howToReplace: See docs/DATA.md. Replace values in place and set each record's verification.status to 'verified' with a source. Nothing in the UI or engine hard-codes these numbers.

verificationLevels.verified: Confirmed against the shipped NBA 2K27 builder or an official 2K source. Safe to trust.
verificationLevels.community-verified: Reproduced independently by multiple credible community testers. Trust with care.
verificationLevels.estimated: Derived or interpolated from partially known data. Directionally useful, numerically approximate.
verificationLevels.unverified: Placeholder. Shaped correctly, numerically meaningless. THIS IS THE DEFAULT.
verificationLevels.deprecated: Known to be wrong / no longer applies. Retained for history, ignored by the engine.

defaultVerification.notes: Placeholder generated with the initial application scaffold.

uiWarnings.globalBanner: Running on PLACEHOLDER NBA 2K27 data. Every rating, cost, cap, badge threshold and animation requirement below is unverified and almost certainly wrong. Replace the files in /data/2k27 with verified data before trusting any build.
